content: Vitest/general testing convention for time-dependent pure functions: prefer dependency injection (pass 'now' as a parameter) over vi.useFakeTimers()/vi.setSystemTime() when the function itself can be written pure -- this is exactly the pattern keebdrill's computeActiveElapsedMs(charLog, markers, now) already established. Fake timers are the fallback for code that calls Date.now()/performance.now() internally and can't be refactored; pure parameter injection is preferred when possible because it keeps the function itself free of runtime imports (matches this codebase's 'zero non-import-type imports' convention in state.ts/active-time.ts).
